title: The Wrong Portrait
author: Marguerite Quintana
blurb: Felix Joubert, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must get the family out ahead of the count before the harvest moon rises.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
